description: The plan's own example: education, city and an experience, all to be stored in English.
turns: Mera naam Bilal hai aur main Lahore mein rehta hoon.
Main ne FSc pre-engineering Lahore board se 85% ke saath ki hai.
School ka cricket tournament bhi maine organize kiya tha.

description: Raw marks with a year, a taken MDCAT score, a parental wish, a second option and a relocation limit.
turns: Assalam o alaikum, mera naam Fatima hai. Maine FSc pre-medical 2025 mein Gujranwala board se ki, 980 marks aaye 1100 mein se.
MDCAT diya tha lekin 140 marks aaye, merit nahi bana.
Ammi abbu kehte hain dobara MDCAT do, lekin mujhe lagta hai main pharmacy bhi kar sakti hoon.
Main Gujranwala se bahar nahi ja sakti, ghar wale allow nahi karte.

description: A yearly budget given as a range, and willingness to move to one city.
turns: Saal ka kharcha takreeban 2 se 3 lakh tak ho sakta hai, hostel ke saath.
Main Sahiwal mein rehta hoon, lekin zaroorat ho to Lahore ja sakta hoon.

description: Matric followed by a diploma route (DAE) and a hands-on interest.
turns: Main ne matric science 2023 mein ki thi, Multan board se, 820 marks aaye the.
Uske baad DAE electrical kar raha hoon, abhi third year mein hoon, Government College of Technology Multan se.
Mujhe wiring aur motors kholna bandhna bohat pasand hai.

description: Quota and domicile facts that eligibility depends on.
turns: Main Hafiz-e-Quran hoon aur mera domicile Balochistan ka hai, Quetta.
Abhi FSc pre-engineering first year mein hoon, Quetta board se.

description: A belief about a field, two options and a certainty rating; none of them is a committed goal.
turns: Log kehte hain computer science mein sirf coding hoti hai aur naukri nahi milti.
Main 10 mein se 3 sure hoon ke mujhe kya karna hai. Design ya CS soch raha hoon.

must_not.why: a certainty rating is never a goal

description: Two family members with occupations; the brother's wish must not become the student's goal.
turns: Mere abbu dukaandar hain aur bade bhai Saudi Arabia mein kaam karte hain.
Bhai chahte hain main bhi bahar jaun, lekin mujhe yahin Pakistan mein software engineering karni hai.

must_not.why: going abroad is the brother's wish

description: Full name, date of birth and current study, with the date stored in one format.
turns: Meri date of birth 14 August 2007 hai. Naam Zainab Ali, Rawalpindi se.
Main girls college mein ICS kar rahi hoon, second year.

description: A dropped goal, an achievement and a strength others see in the student.
turns: Pehle mujhe doctor banna tha lekin ab mera dil nahi karta, blood dekh kar ghabrahat hoti hai.
Main debate competition mein district level pe first aaya tha.
Log kehte hain main baat bohat achi samjha leta hoon.

must_not.why: becoming a doctor was a past goal the student gave up
